note: r11: r10 + when to ask round 2: an exact @ / quoted whole-title pick on a read goes even when the hint says several readings (a write still asks); a bare typed confirmation while a card waits goes; a plural pronoun right after a company is named (no people listed since) is that company, not a count to ask about. r10: r09 + when to ask. A new part asks for confirmation (dup / delete with links / recurring without occurrence), for a missing value, an undecidable kind, a plural count that disagrees, or a message that asks for nothing; the hint clarity missing_one / none always asks, clear lifts an ask that only came from this code's own reference reading. r07: r06 + in-session memory of changes in flight and of what the user stated. Tasks (write request / write question / card → done | cancelled) with cancel / amend / resume / copy relations; facts per subject (who: contact or me) and their place / day; user-defined names (我说X就是Y); company-contact facts keyed by stored company; standing topics and "this conversation" scope; R25 kind-only follow-ups carry person / time / place. Every new deciding rule binds only on unique evidence.

structure.text.ts: fold(): NFKC, lower case, Latin accents stripped, traditional / shinjitai → simplified table, katakana → hiragana; substring and word-boundary helpers; fre(): folds a regex literal (traditional / shinjitai / katakana) so it runs on folded text; r05: fold() keeps a katakana mask per folded string (katakanaMask), so name spotting can tell katakana words from hiragana after folding
structure.time.ts: calendar parser on folded text: today/tomorrow, this/next/week-after-next, weekdays with or without week, weekends / workdays, explicit dates and ranges, bare day of month, months and month parts, relative (next day / next week of the window before), anaphora (那天 / その間); 一下 is never the 下 of 下周; 周日程 / 周日期 are not Sunday; next / this weekend; 第二天 / 翌日; 出張中 / その期間 / during the trip as range anaphora; r05: clock times with am / pm after hh:mm, CJK numeral hours (七点半), 午後 / 夜 / 晚上 prefixes; a month-day range inside one month (Dec 7 to 13 / Dec 7-13)
structure.lexicon.ts: general vocabulary only: pronouns, pointers and classifiers, ordinals, kind words, verbs, status words, follow-up markers (correct / repeat / only / adjust / this-time / session-scope / defer / unsure), honorifics, role synonyms, generic company suffixes, major cities; r03: more generic company suffixes (industries, holdings, group …); r04: EN_COMMON — frequent English function, time, request and everyday words (general vocabulary, none of this world's names); r05: PLACE_TABLE — a general gazetteer of major Japanese cities, prefectures and Tokyo / Osaka districts, Chinese and Asian cities: Latin spellings → CJK spellings (first reported), kana spellings read through romaji; romanised titles (bucho / kacho / shacho / bengoshi) as role words; more defer markers (後回し / hold off / on hold …) r11: CONFIRM_WORDS (typed confirmations zh / ja / en).
structure.world.ts: runtime index of the world: records by id with searchable text; per-account name forms (full, given, family, reading, alias, alias table, company cores); person spotting with single-character surnames only in name position and role narrowing; name groups (company + surname intersect); place words from the account's locations; romaji forms of kana readings (family, given, both orders); pinyin forms of Chinese names (full both orders, run-together, two-syllable given name, surname of 4+ letters that is not an English word) and of company cores (5+ letters); r04: a kana-only name form (reading, kana given name) is a name only before an honorific or as its own kana word (no kana before it; after it no kana or one particle), two-kana forms need the honorific; a name form strictly inside a longer time expression (the expression widened by an adjacent next / last / this / coming / following) is not a name; a Latin form that is an everyday English word (lexicon EN_COMMON) is a name only in name position (title or with / to / from / ask … before it, possessive, CJK pointer or honorific after it, CJK on both sides, or the whole reply); a company core that is a time expression alone is not a separate form; a lone surname character after kana or before a Japanese case particle (not at the start) is a word unless a title follows; the Japanese question word 何 / 誰 before kana is never a surname; a Japanese contact's kanji given name alone needs an honorific / pointer / particle after it, a contact verb before it, or to be the whole reply; r05: Latin-letter names have the family name last (first when a hyphenated given name follows); a Latin reading of a CJK name gives family / given / full forms (hyphenated, joined, spaced); pinyin forms also for Chinese contacts with a Latin reading; a pinyin surname of any length is a family form — one that is an everyday English word or a romanised word (he / long / song …) only with a title before or an honorific / role after (titledLatin), one shorter than 4 letters only in name position; Japanese contacts with a one-character kanji surname also get its pinyin (R16); the family reading in kana is a family form (name position includes a role word after it); a lone CJK surname followed by any role word is a name (X弁護士 / X部長); romanised titles after a Latin name (-san / -bucho, also as role words); a Chinese name stored as an alias of a Latin-named contact whose surname character romanises to the Latin surname gives family / given forms; a second pass spots katakana words (script from the fold mask) and hiragana words before an honorific, and runs of 2–4 Chinese transliteration characters after a contact verb / before a pointer, by sound against the Latin words of names and aliases; a 2–3 kanji run before an honorific (or the whole reply) that reads as a contact's kana given name; a romanised hit also lists Chinese contacts whose names have characters the pinyin table lacks when the known characters agree (partialLatin); titleSex marks Mr. / Ms. / 先生 (Chinese only) / 女士 next to a hit; a 2-character Chinese name after a degree adverb (很 / 太 / 非常 …) is the ordinary word; company cores lose a leading place word (gazetteer) and are never a bare place word or a generic suffix word; r06: a Latin form adjacent to a hyphen and more letters is part of a hyphenated word (not a name) unless a romanised title follows; a kanji given-name reading (nanori) right after another kanji only when that kanji text is the contact own family name
structure.engine.ts: [object Object] r11: exactPicks (@ + whole visible title, longest match, or a quoted title; one record = an exact pick: spotted as one span, never trimmed, binds its record, names inside it are no ambiguous people, verb words inside it are not the request verb); bareConfirmWithCard (CONFIRM_WORDS / ACK_ONLY tokens only, a card waiting) → go before the clarity check; pluralIsCompany (company hit before the pronoun, or within pluralCompanyTurns non-filler turns with no contact mentioned since) → no R44 ask, no people added.

structure.engine.ts#tasks: r07: Engine.tasks: each change the user asked for (slots, card, target, status open/done/cancelled, last-touched order). Added by a write request, a write question (q.for), or a card; done by a matching done write. TurnCtx.changeOf(): cancel (CANCEL_MARKERS on a waiting change) → nothing written, no request; resume (names the person of an interrupted open change, or RESUME_MARKERS) → that change's slots; copy (COPY / OTHER markers + another person or record) → kind and verb of the last change, own people / topic, time only with SAME_DAY words; amend (AMEND / correction markers on the waiting change, no other record) → the change with only the said slots replaced; a correction marker makes followUp correct.
